notablePrerequisites: You have no instants and/or sorceries in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch's first ability triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
